title: Senior RF Design Engineer
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
Position Overview
Analog Devices is looking for an intelligent and versatile
Senior RFIC Design Engineer
to work with our
RF Semiconductors
team, based in
Istanbul, Turkey
, who will be responsible for product developments such as
RF Beamformers, Up-Down Converters, Mixers, Detectors, Switches, Attenuators, Filters, Phase Shifters, Amplifiers
for various markets.
Context on the role
As a Senior RFIC Design Engineer, you are an experienced and fully competent engineer in your area. You’ll complete your role independently or working under limited direction. You’ll resolve problems of diverse scope using analysis and judgment within defined policies and practices, and you’ll communicate your work in a way that’s reflected in others’ work. You may also mentor and professionally influence the growth of more junior engineers.
Job Duties
Integrated circuit design at transistor level for RF blocks
Design evaluation, including first-silicon characterization and detailed analysis
Design and development for RF products with various process and packaging technologies
Problem resolution for issues requiring analysis of identifiable factors, developing approaches and recommendations within defined practices
Project contributions and leadership, representing the organization on projects and, as needed, taking on a project leadership role
Cross-functional communication, including effective group communication and frequent inter-organizational and outside customer contacts where required
Documentation, preparing required documentation and reports for product development
Mentorship, supporting the career growth and technical development of lower-level employees
Requirements
Degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering (M.S. preferred; PhD a plus)
Typically requires 4+ years relevant experience
Solid understanding of S-parameters, transmission line theory, and RF networks
Skills necessary to innovate, design, simulate, and verify circuit performance at the transistor level and behavioral/architectural level, with strong RF fundamentals
Experience in circuit design environments such as Cadence and ADS
Skills in electromagnetic simulators such as EMPro and/or HFSS (plus)
Demonstrated IC tape-out experience is needed
Experience in test equipment and RF characterization (plus)
Motivated, results-oriented, and organized engineer with good writing, presentation, and overall communication skills
Willingness and ability to learn something new quickly
Comfortable taking calculated risks
Bias for action and collaboration to deliver results
Why you will like working at ADI
We place great value on individual judgment.
We allow our employees the freedom to explore new ideas and the autonomy to determine how to best achieve business goals and objectives.
We emphasize professional development and mentoring.
Above all, we recognize that the personal goals of our employees and the company’s goals are closely related and must support each other.
